First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.VxJKyJDX5JtaCOX7]{Crownvale}

Description

A sergeant-at-arms in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric}'s guard, responsible for escorting @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira}.
A dutiful soldier with personal troubles — his wife has been unfaithful.

Role

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric} charmed him into abandoning his post briefly for drinks and pumped him for information about @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric}.
The information he provided suggests Aldric was not directly involved in the ruin's release.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson} — His lord and commander
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Ro74hUOP2RdYxDzh]{Captain Vask} — The head of Aldric's guard and his superior, whom he openly defied at the Witch Stones
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira} — In his charge as escort
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} — Who Favored him at the Witch Stones, leaving a bond of obligation between them
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} — Charmed into sharing information over drinks

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1} — Edric bought him drinks and extracted information about Aldric; Edric experienced a disturbing compulsion to weaponize knowledge of Iyer's personal troubles
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2} — Reports from Aureate soldiers indicate Iyer was on duty when half the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.VxJKyJDX5JtaCOX7]{Crownvale} guard walked off the walls in the middle of the night; he told them to go home, saying none of it mattered anymore; the east gate stood unmanned until dawn, suggesting ruin's influence is deepening its hold on Crownvale's defenders
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — At the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} he tackled @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} to the ground on Captain Vask's behalf, then defied his own captain — pushing Vask back — to let Garland pursue @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira} through the portal, after Garland Favored him and swore to bring her back to Crownvale on his life; openly defying Vask before the families and soldiers will likely bring trouble from the captain and from Aldric

Session Appearances
